description: SPC- Statistical Process Control as a foundational tool of Six Sigma methodology, is a technique utilized in manufacturing and process industries to monitor, control, and improve processes by employing statistical methods. The primary objective of SPC is to ensure that processes operate efficiently and consistently, producing high-quality output while minimizing variation. SPC apply statistical probability theory to monitor process fluctuations and to keep them under control. One of the main metrics in SPC is the Process Performance Index (Ppk) or its short term equivalent Process Capability Index (Cpk). Both are powerful statistical measure to assess the performance and capability of a process. They quantifies the process’s ability to meet specifications and provides insights into how well a process can consistently produce results within specified limits. Ppk/Cpk helps quality professionals and process engineers assess process performance. It ensures products or services meet customer expectations and maintain a competitive edge. The SPC Visual calculates the Pp(k)/Cp(k) values according to ISO 22514 norm considering different probability distributions such as normal, weilbull, exponential, beta, logistic, gamma, cauchy, ..etc. History / Versions: 1.0 First version. Integrates: Individual chart, Capability chart, Probability chart, Moving range chart, Distribution estimation…
